capacity_gross_kwh.notes: ArenaEV: 100 kWh (Model X Long Range 2019-2021, total).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Model S Long Range+ page; same 100 kWh Raven pack on the Model X. ArenaEV Model S Long Range+ 2020: 94 kWh net. Compare 95 on the 2019 page and 98 in an EV Database snippet for the LR Plus (not fetched).

chemistry.notes: EVSpecifications 2017-2018 Model S/X: NCA (Panasonic NCR18650A, LiNiCoAlO2); Wikipedia Model S: NCA cathode.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Pack voltage 300-407 V (EVSpecifications: 302 V 75 kWh, 346 V 85/90 kWh, 400-407 V 100 kWh; ArenaEV 300-360 V), well below 800 V: 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla release note (software 2020.24.6, Electrek) for Model S/X: "when you navigate to a Supercharger, your car will condition its battery during the drive"; lineup-wide software feature. No manual control found; tesla.com manuals are blocked (403). Cars without navigation or on the oldest MCU1 hardware (2012-2017) may not run it: unconfirmed.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: Tesla lists up to 250 kW for newly ordered Model S/X (2020, undated page), after 225 kW by software 2020.24.6 (Electrek) and 200 kW at launch; cars built before mid-2020 may still be 225 kW. No Model X page; same Raven charger family as the Model S.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: No Model X page states the standard onboard charger: ArenaEV X pages list 11 kW or 16.5 kW, EVSpecifications 2018 X P100D lists 17.28 kW and X Plaid pages 7.4 / 16.5 kW. Standard 48 A / 11.5 kW taken from the same-year Model S (EVSpecifications 2017-2018 S, 2023/2025 S Plaid); higher-amperage chargers were optional.
